methodology.observation_window_basis: Window starts at the previous successful canonical run's window_end and ends at the current observation cutoff.
methodology.ranking_basis: Signal strength rather than popularity, emphasizing difficult-to-reverse commercialization, deployment, infrastructure, manufacturing, regulatory, and technical milestones.
methodology.source_policy: Prefer primary company, government, regulatory, and research-institution sources; use high-quality reporting only when a primary announcement could not be located during the run.
methodology.repeat_policy: Canonical event fingerprints were checked; repeated events are included only for material updates with preserved event_key and material_update_from.

provenance.notes: Immutable-ledger-only persistence; legacy history and visual artifacts were not read or rewritten.

findings.headline: U.S. Energy Department commits nearly $2 billion to unlock more than 23 GW from the existing grid
findings.summary: The U.S. Energy Department is allocating nearly $2 billion across 31 projects in 26 states to increase usable capacity on existing transmission infrastructure. The projects are expected to unlock more than 23 GW using technologies including real-time weather sensing and power-flow controls.
findings.why_it_matters: This is a large-scale move to treat grid-enhancing technologies as near-term capacity infrastructure rather than waiting solely for new transmission construction. The program directly targets the electricity bottleneck being intensified by AI and data-center demand.
findings.trend_statement: Grid modernization is shifting toward extracting materially more capacity from existing rights-of-way through sensors, controls, and other grid-enhancing technologies.

source_links.title: Associated Press — Energy Department to spend nearly $2 billion on aging power grid

findings.headline: NASA selects PRIMA as first Probe Explorers mission and advances it to Phase B
findings.summary: NASA selected the PRobe far-Infrared Mission for Astrophysics as the first mission in its new Probe Explorers class and moved it into Phase B preliminary design and technology development. Subject to a later confirmation review, the mission has a project-cost cap of $1.2 billion excluding launch and targets a 2033 launch for a five-year mission.
findings.why_it_matters: Selection into Phase B converts a competed mission concept into a funded development program and establishes NASA's new mid-scale Probe Explorers mission class, creating a repeatable tier between smaller Explorer missions and flagship observatories.
findings.trend_statement: NASA is institutionalizing a new mid-scale astrophysics mission pipeline while committing PRIMA to formal preliminary design and technology maturation.

source_links.title: NASA — NASA Selects Far-Infrared Telescope as First in New Mission Class

findings.headline: AGIBOT deploys more than 300 robots at Chimelong as its 20,000th production robot is delivered
findings.summary: AGIBOT and Chimelong launched the first phase of a deployment placing more than 300 robots into entertainment, education, visitor services, and hotel operations at Chimelong Spaceship Park. The launch coincided with delivery of AGIBOT's 20,000th production robot and uses dedicated connectivity, multi-robot coordination, and safety systems.
findings.why_it_matters: The combination of a 20,000-unit manufacturing milestone and a single-site deployment measured in hundreds of robots is stronger commercialization evidence than prototype demonstrations. It also exposes the operational infrastructure required to run embodied-AI fleets in public environments.
findings.trend_statement: Embodied AI is progressing from demonstrations toward fleet-scale public deployment backed by repeatable manufacturing and dedicated operating infrastructure.

source_links.title: AGIBOT — AGIBOT and Chimelong Launch Large-Scale Embodied AI Theme Park with More Than 300 Robots

category_assessments.justification: A fleet-scale deployment and 20,000-unit production milestone provide unusually strong evidence that embodied AI is moving into scaled manufacturing and sustained real-world operation.
